issue.title: bob-ledger-tools re-runs failing bob list/report commands on every workspace event with no failure cache or backoff
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-o6.1 (note #3, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-o6 land agent. In the title-slot spike (5-note scratch vault, bob refused by a shim, 102 s of file switches and mode changes) bob-ledger-tools made 755 child invocations, about 7.4/s: gmail list 150, albums list 99, notebooks list 97, projects list 97, areas list 85, and bank report, config, and subscriptions 74 each. Failures are retried on ordinary workspace events with no caching or backoff. Consider caching failures or backing off while bob is missing or failing.

task_type_fields.impact: Any host where bob is missing, mid-upgrade, or failing pays ~7/s of doomed subprocess spawns during ordinary editing, adding load exactly when the host is already unhealthy
task_type_fields.location: plugins/bob-ledger-tools workspace-event refresh lanes (bob list/report invocations)
task_type_fields.repro: Run the o6.1 title-slot spike setup: isolated vault with a bob shim that exits nonzero, then switch files and modes for ~100 s and count invocations in the shim log (755 observed)

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-o6.1 note #3 measured a subprocess storm while bob was refusing; filed by the bob-cli-o6 land agent so a broken or missing bob stops costing a subprocess per workspace event.
